[#entidad-observed-fingerprint-rule]
= Observed fingerprint rule

Rule that corrects the automatic grouping of the errors: group-as puts in one issue the events whose field matches the pattern; ignore-frame leaves the matching stack frames out of the fingerprint (wrappers, retries); drop keeps the events as logs but never as issues (noise of bots or browser extensions).
